hero.headline: Pixpa vs Strikingly
hero.subheadline: A side-by-side comparison for buyers, operators, and affiliate-content readers.

summary.best_for_a: Pixpa is best for photographers, designers and creatives who need portfolio-ready templates, client galleries, and built‑in e‑commerce and proofing tools.
summary.best_for_b: Strikingly is best for individuals and small businesses who want to launch a clean, one‑page site or simple store quickly with minimal setup.
summary.quick_take: Pixpa focuses on creative professionals with portfolio templates, client proofing, and integrated selling—great if you need galleries, client workflows, and a store. Strikingly excels at speed and simplicity: you can launch a polished one‑page website in minutes and keep costs low. Choose Pixpa if you need portfolio-driven features and more control; choose Strikingly if you want the fastest path to a small site or basic online store.

paragraphs: Pixpa and Strikingly are both beginner-friendly website builders, but they target different needs. Pixpa is built around portfolios, client galleries and integrated commerce for creatives, while Strikingly focuses on one‑page sites and simple stores for users who want a fast setup.

This comparison looks at design flexibility, portfolio and e‑commerce features, ease of use, SEO and pricing to help you decide which builder converts visitors into clients and sales for your specific use case.

data.headline: Pixpa for portfolio power; Strikingly for quick one‑page sites
data.summary: If your priority is a visual portfolio, client proofing, and built‑in selling, Pixpa offers more tailored features. If you want an ultra‑simple, fast‑to‑launch website or a low-friction store, Strikingly delivers. Both are solid — pick based on whether you value creative tools or speed and simplicity.

items.question: Which is better for photographers?
items.answer: Pixpa is the better choice for photographers because of its gallery layouts, client proofing, watermarking and easy digital delivery.

items.question: Can I sell digital products on both platforms?
items.answer: Yes—both support selling digital products, but Pixpa offers more specialized sales and delivery features for creatives while Strikingly handles simpler storefronts.

items.question: Is there a free plan or trial?
items.answer: Strikingly offers a free plan with limitations; Pixpa provides a free trial period so you can test portfolio and commerce features before committing.

items.question: Which builder is better for SEO?
items.answer: Both offer basic SEO controls like meta tags and sitemaps; Pixpa gives more granular control for multi‑page portfolios and content, while Strikingly covers standard needs for one‑page sites.

items.question: Can I move my site from one platform to the other?
items.answer: You can migrate content such as images and text, but templates and built‑in gallery functionality won’t transfer directly—expect manual setup on the new platform.

items.question: Which one is better value for a small business?
items.answer: If you need a fast, low‑cost presence, Strikingly offers great value. If your small business relies on visual portfolios, client workflows or selling services/products, Pixpa provides better long‑term value.
